$comment: Average rates on new housing loans by track, August 2026 (nominal annual %). Linked tracks are real rates before CPI. Source: Bank of Israel monthly report on housing loans (report 877), published 14/09/2026.

period.note: Month the figures describe. BOI publishes about two weeks after month end. File: boi_files/Pikuah/dy260831.xlsx.

prime.label: פריים
prime.note: dy260831.xlsx, table 877-2, unlinked variable loans whose rate can change within a month (prime-based): anchor 5.11% − margin 0.67%.

fixedUnlinked.label: קבועה לא צמודה
fixedUnlinked.note: dy260831.xlsx, table 877-2, unlinked fixed-rate loans, all terms. Same as BOI series BNK_99034_LR_BIR_MRTG_467.

fixedLinked.label: קבועה צמודה
fixedLinked.note: dy260831.xlsx, table 877-1, CPI-linked fixed-rate loans, all terms (real rate). Same as BOI series BNK_99034_LR_BIR_MRTG_1492.

variableUnlinked5y.label: משתנה כל 5 שנים לא צמודה
variableUnlinked5y.note: dy260831.xlsx, table 877-2, unlinked variable loans with the next rate change in 2–5 years: anchor 3.51% + margin 0.98%.

variableLinked5y.label: משתנה כל 5 שנים צמודה
variableLinked5y.note: dy260831.xlsx, table 877-1, CPI-linked variable loans with the next rate change in 2–5 years: anchor 1.63% + margin 1.79% (real rate).

fixedRateByOriginBucket.$comment: Range of yearly average rates on new UNLINKED FIXED housing loans for each origination period (compared with fixedUnlinked in the fee estimate). Min and max of the yearly averages, rounded outward to 0.1.

before2015.note: Yearly averages 2009–2014: 5.43, 5.54, 5.70, 4.92, 4.25, 3.81. 2009–2012 from BOI mashfix.xls (fixed unlinked, loans to 28.02.2013); 2013–2014 from BOI series BNK_99034_LR_BIR_MRTG_467. Loans before 2009 not covered.

2015to2019.note: Yearly averages 2015–2019: 3.28, 3.93, 4.20, 3.89, 3.68. Series BNK_99034_LR_BIR_MRTG_467 (BOI SDMX API, dataflow BIR_MRTG_99).

2020to2022.note: Yearly averages 2020–2022: 3.15, 3.06, 4.11. Series BNK_99034_LR_BIR_MRTG_467 (BOI SDMX API, dataflow BIR_MRTG_99).

since2023.note: Yearly averages 2023–2026 (2026 = Jan–Aug): 5.02, 4.93, 4.88, 4.71. Series BNK_99034_LR_BIR_MRTG_467 (BOI SDMX API, dataflow BIR_MRTG_99).
